scope: Initial longitudinal Western sample beginning with Socrates and Plato; not a universal or ranked canon.

cohort.label: Socrates
cohort.source_boundary: Reconstructed through early witnesses, principally Plato and Xenophon.

admission_rules.concept_gap: A reusable concept or decisive distinction recurs in at least three cohort members, lacks an adequate existing owner, and survives taxonomy and product review.
admission_rules.navigation_gap: Existing owners cover the structure but the ordinary-language route is absent or materially misleading.
admission_rules.proper_name_only: A doctrine, work, school, or named formulation that does not survive removal of the proper name is not a Factorium concept gap.

stop: Complete the frozen cohort once, retain interpretive disagreement and absences, and admit no Table solely because a famous philosopher used a term.
